newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK CPI (A) rises annual 6.6 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: HK CPI (A) rises annual 6.6 pct in January.

text.p: The Census and Statistics Department released the following consumer price index data on Monday showing Hong Kong's CPI (A) rose 6.6 percent in January year-on-year.
CPI (A), Hong Kong's broadest measure of inflation, is based on the 50 percent of households spending between HK$4,000 and HK$15,999 a month as of the fiscal 1994/95 base year.
CPI (B) is based on the 30 percent of households which spend HK$16,000 to HK$29,999 a month as of the 1994/95 base year.
Hang Seng CPI Jan '97 Dec '96 Jan '96
The Hang Seng CPI, published by Hang Seng Bank Ltd, is based on the 10 percent of households spending HK$30,000 to HK$59,999 a month as of the 1994/95 base year.
The composite CPI is based on the combined expenditure pattern of households covered by the three CPI's.
